intro: The second leg of route 1 is the ride (mini-game M1): the kid rides the Enoden tram from Hase toward Kamakura. Its set is built from your three photographic set pictures, KM1-2a to c, for your approval.
A fixed side-on camera inside the tram: the car's far wall across the aisle, the town sliding past its windows, the stations outside the door at each stop. The kid stands in the aisle with the ball.
reference: KM1-2 Ride the Enoden's set pictures: KM1-2a, the car inside (shown here), with KM1-2b, the town passing, and KM1-2c, the three stations.
strip: The set as the game camera frames it: the car's far wall, the town behind its windows (here at rest), Yuigahama's platform outside the door, the grandmother who boards there. The ride's own camera is inside the car and frames the car alone; the board's, further back, also sees over the car's wall. The shading is Blender's, not the game's toon look.
decided: The ride (docs/CITIES.md, M1): board by tapping the card reader in time, before the door chime ends; keep the ball still against the sway with the stick and hold KICK through a hard brake; give your seat to the grandmother who boards at Yuigahama for a bonus; press STOP at Kamakura when the next-stop display names it. A missed stop makes the next leg longer.
The town slides past behind the windows and repeats (its ends meet). At each stop the train halts with a platform outside the door: Yuigahama, Wadazuka, then Kamakura.
Cost (est., docs/PERFORMANCE.md): five models, 30 triangles, one 4096 x 2048 texture (about 11 MB with mips in ETC2 with alpha, about 5 MB in ASTC 6x6).
ask: The set: is the car as your picture has it, the town in its windows and the stations at the door what you want the ride to look like?
